detail.title: Titan 1500 D (TW 13503) FMUB - 2.0 Tower Speaker (150W)
detail.overview: Experience unmatched sound clarity and bass with the Intex Titan 1500 (D) (TW 13503) 2.0 Tower Speaker. Designed for music enthusiasts, this speaker boasts 150W of power, dual 10-inch woofers, and mid-range speakers for a balanced audio experience. The dual UHF cordless karaoke microphones, wired MIC jack, and recording function make it perfect for karaoke lovers. Bluetooth v5.0 ensures seamless connectivity, while the informative LED display and multimode playability options (USB, AUX, FM, BT, MIC) offer maximum convenience.
features: 150W powerful sound output for a superior audio experience
Dual 10-inch (25.4 cm) woofers for deep and pulsating bass
Mid-range speakers (4-inch x 2) for enhanced clarity
Multimode playability: USB, AUX, FM, Bluetooth, and MIC
Dual UHF cordless karaoke microphones for seamless performances
Wired MIC jack for additional microphone connectivity
Recording feature: REC AUX, BT & FM to USB
Portable Bluetooth v5.0 speaker with a 10-meter wireless range
Informative LED display for easy control and navigation
High-end audio quality with optimized treble and bass
